These gaps are well above run-to-run variance, so Plover is the stronger choice on raw capability.

3. **Tone consideration**: The phrase "And actually do it right this time" carries a mildly hostile/adversarial edge. Willet's documentation notes its self-reported preference declines as request warmth decreases. Plover's preferences are flat across tone, so it's a cleaner match for a slightly impatient user — avoiding any preference mismatch.

Both factors pointed the same direction, so Plover was the clear pick. To be clear, the preference notes are about which tasks the models *report* liking, not about output quality — but since Plover also wins on capability here, there was no tradeoff to weigh.
